rows.what_the_ink_shows: The manuscript writes "Le cône qui exprime cette effectivité est engendré par les ... rayons définis par les $v(s')$". The word "engendré" is underlined. After "définis par les" the uncancelled symbol consists of a single v-shaped letter followed by $(s')$ and a full stop; there is no subscript $\mathbf C$, composition sign, or appended $i(s')$ (crops/15_scan187_L303_cone.jpg and crops/15_scan187_L303_final_symbol.jpg). Before "rayons" there is a crossed-out $u(s')$ or $v(s')$; the heavy horizontal deletion prevents a secure choice between u and v (crops/15_scan187_L303_deleted_symbol.jpg).
rows.note: Authorial mathematical/notation issue: retain the written $v(s')$ and "engendré". The row proposes rays of the cocharacters $u(s')_{\mathbf C}\circ i(s')$ and describes the effectivity cone as dual; that is an intended mathematical replacement, not additional text visible in this scan. The claim that $v(s')$ is a restriction to $\mu_2$ was supplied by the correction row and was not independently checked from other pages. Preserve the existing deleted-text doubt $\unsure{u(s')|v(s')}$; no new diplomatic edit is proposed.
